jobs.label: Internal Tools Engineer — exposure wording at volume, including two lines where an exposure word sits next to a production ask
jobs.description:
We are hiring an Internal Tools Engineer for the team that builds and runs the services our support staff work in all day.

Essential:
- Python
- Familiar with the production challenges of Kubernetes
- Exposure to Terraform in a production environment

We would also like:
- Familiarity with Kubernetes
- Awareness of Terraform or a similar infrastructure-as-code tool
- Some exposure to Go
- Basic Redis knowledge
- Willingness to learn Kafka
